visual_enhancers.gradients: Use strictly for glows and accents, never for full backgrounds unless overlaid with noise/texture
visual_enhancers.shadows: Colored shadows matching the note color (glow effect)

components_map.calculator: Use Shadcn Dialog or a draggable custom component. Style it like a Teenage Engineering synth - tactile, mono fonts, high contrast.
components_map.color_picker: Popover with circular swatches. Must show the glow effect on hover.
components_map.grid_controls: A slider or button group (1x, 2x, 3x, 4x, 5x) to dynamically change grid-cols className.
components_map.alarm_settings: Dialog with sound selection (Bell, Chime, Signal), Haptic toggle (switch), and Time picker.
components_map.share_modal: Dialog with 'Copy Link', 'Send Email', 'Send Message' buttons using big icons.

instructions_to_main_agent: IMPLEMENT THE GRID CONTROL: The user specifically asked for '1 row or 7 rows' control. Create a UI element (slider or segmented control) that updates the main grid's 'grid-cols-X' class.
CALCULATOR: Build a functional calculator (add, sub, mul, div) inside a modal or a side widget. Don't just make it UI.
NOTES: Each note must have a 'Created at' timestamp (use JetBrains Mono) and an 'Alarm' indicator if set.
HEADER: Use the provided 'header_bg' as a subtle background image with a gradient overlay (to black) so text remains readable. Place the 'company_logo' on the left.
Ensure the app is fully responsive. Mobile defaults to 1 column.
Use 'sonner' for toast notifications when sharing or setting alarms.
Do NOT use gradients for note backgrounds - use solid colors with very low opacity (10-20%) and colored borders/shadows to achieve the 'glass' look.

universal_guidelines.contrast: Ensure text is legible on colored note backgrounds. Use white text for all dark notes.
universal_guidelines.interactions: All interactive elements must have :hover and :active states.
universal_guidelines.accessibility: Use aria-labels on all icon-only buttons.
